name: Parallelogram Prediction with Diamond Residuals
definition: Lossless compression of height fields using linear prediction. Height values are uniformly quantized to 16 bits. Parallelogram prediction is used for the z-component. Vertices are traversed in diagonal rows. The first three vertices of the first triangle are stored uncompressed. Subsequent vertices are predicted using a diamond configuration to maximize square diamond configurations, ensuring predictor vertices are close in the domain.
